diagnosis.maskedError: TinkerError: TINKER_API_KEY was not exported into the Banking77 process
diagnosis.rootCause: The env file was sourced without shell auto-export; the sidecar had the key but the checkpoint sampler process did not.
diagnosis.fix: Launch Banking77 with set -a before sourcing the protected env, then set +a; install tinker, transformers, and jinja2 in that runtime.
